name: Obsidian Skills
tagline: Agent skills for Obsidian — teach your agent to use Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, and CLI.
description: Collection of agent skills for Obsidian integration. Teaches AI agents to work with Obsidian's core features: Markdown editing, Obsidian Bases (structured data), JSON Canvas (visual note linking), and command-line interface. Enables agents to create, edit, organize, and visualize notes within Obsidian. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and other AI agents supporting the Agent Skills spec.
author: kepano
